Since we don’t want to ban the DK bots in BGs, I have a brand new solution to make it better than new. I’d like to request that Blizzard simply add new functionality to their APIs that the DK bots can use so that everyone will have more fun playing with their new AI ChatGPT friends. Some ideas for the new DK bot functionality below:

PickUpFlag() → DKs never run the flag in WSG, this will definitely help the team out
CapFlag() → See above ^
ReturnFlag() → Sure, 8 DKs stacked together will kill the flag carrier, but they need an easy way to cap the flag afterwards
AttackDemolisher() → sure the DK bots are great and everyone loves it when they’re in strand of the Ancients with you, but I noticed they just straight up run by demolishers, BLIZZARD YOU NEED TO HELP THEM ATTACK DEMOLISHERS, it’s not their fault, they just need your help.
ManTurret() → similar to above they just need a little help, it’s not their fault
SpaceOutALittleBro() → this could send a signal to other bots to space them out a little, I do love seeing 15 of them stacked together, but it’s just kinda nice if they have their own space, especially after all of them rez at a graveyard
HoldTrinketForASec() → it’s great to see a DK use their trinket .0001 seconds after a cheap shot, but I’m afraid this is ruining my immersion a little bit, I think if they hold their trinket, say until CC is stacked or maybe until .0002 seconds it might be more realistic
HoldMindFreezeYouFreakOfNatureIJustStartedCasting() → I think the name of this method really flows, but anyway similar to above I think this could really help DK bot immersion
DontQueueYetINeedToRepair() → DK bots are dedicated gamers to be sure, but queues usually aren’t instant. I think it would be really nice if you added an option for them to repair before games. I see a naked DK with 11k HP running around WSG and I am blown away by their dedication to the horde cause, but they should be taken care of in Dalaran. You could even add a special vendor to do it for free so they continue to sell premium gold and wreck the economy
DontBreakMyCCBro() → as a rogue, I have to admit I really like it when I blind a trinket and sap off in order to kill an enemy player and they get deathgripped across the map by a DK bot, I just love their enthusiasm! But sometimes I think it would be cool for them to not break CC and use a little bit of strategy
HumanSpeak() → I think this is the thing I’m most excited about. I think it would be really cool to add an API so the bots could talk. So that when you asked a DK to say potato if they’re not a bot they could be like "Potato silly willy " I know that you love your Classic fanbase and are willing to invest so much to make our subscriptions worth it so that’s why I think you could collab with ChatGPT on this! Maybe this method could tunnel all the player chat to ChatGPT and maybe the ChatGPT could be configured to think it’s a wow player or something. I think it could be so exciting!

Anyway those are my suggestions for now. I’m really really glad you all are taking the botting so seriously and that this game isn’t just a cash grab for a bunch of execs that don’t give a damn about gaming! Til next time!
